note: *He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock* — the gathering hand named in Jer 31:10 is the *Yah* in Yahusha's name.
*I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for mine holy name's sake* — the Yah who saves in Matt 1:21 saves for his own name's sake; the gospel is name-grace, not merit-grace.

*I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land* — the early-ministry geographic-scope summary as the beginning of the Ezek 37 gathering.
The second-gathering prophecy; *shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.*
*I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone* — the Ezekiel 37 gathering-prophecy companion.
The eschatological-gathering-with-sifting the present-age mission-to-Yashar'el (Israel) is moving toward.

*I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land* — the good-seed-of-the-children-of-the-kingdom is the same gathered-remnant the Tanakh-prophets name.
*His people* in 1:21 is locked by 15:24's *the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — same mission scope at the front door of the gospel as at the Canaanite-woman pericope.
Rachab dwelt in Yashar'el (Israel) *even unto this day* — the grafting is settled, not perpetually open.

*Thy people shall be my people, and thy Elohim (God) my Elohim (God)* — Ruth's specific Yah-ordained transfer from the Moavite peripheral-Avrahamic branch into the Yashar'eli (Israelite) covenant body.

*He shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth* — both houses, named, gathered.

*Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head* — the one head Hosea names is the Messiah Matthew is genealogizing.
*They saw the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) ... they saw Elohim (God), and did eat and drink* — the seventy elders see the Formed. The Formless is not what is seen; the Formed is.
*There shall come a Star out of Ya'aqov (Jacob), and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the Balaam prophecy of the Star-and-Sceptre that the Magi recognized.
The pillar of cloud and fire that led Yashar'el (Israel) in the wilderness — the Tanakh-pattern for the shekinah-leading-by-visible-sign that the Matthew-2 star manifests.
Edom refusing passage to Yashar'el (Israel) at the wilderness border — the earliest beat of the Edom-against-Yashar'el pattern.

*When Yashar'el (Israel) was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt* — Yashar'el (Israel) as Yahuah's (God's) firstborn son brought out of Egypt at the Exodus; Matthew applies the verse to Yahusha (Jesus) as the embodiment of Yashar'el (Israel).

The patriarch Yoseph (Joseph) bringing Ya'aqov (Jacob) and his sons down to Egypt — the Tanakh-Yoseph initiating the Egypt-sojourn that the Matthew-Yoseph (Joseph) re-walks with the Messianic-Yashar'el (Israel) in his arms.

*I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Yashar'el (Israel), and Ephraim is my firstborn* — the gathering of the northern house, which Rachel's children (Yoseph (Joseph) and Binyamin (Benjamin)) are most associated with.
The betrothal-restoration of divorced-Yashar'el (Israel).
*I am married unto you* — addressed to *backsliding children;* the bridegroom-substance over scattered-Yashar'el (Israel).
*Ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the eschatological-promise that locks the twelve-apostle / twelve-tribe correspondence.

*Twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the same architecture from the twelve-tribe-side.
The centurion-pericope as parallel test-case — individual-nations-figure with God-fearer-Yashar'el (Israel)-attachment receives-mercy.
*I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel)* — the centurion-pericope's-faith-honoring substance parallel.
The substantial-substance-of-the-Yashar'el-and-the-nations-gathered against-the-Father's-anointed.
*Go ... rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — `lost-sheep-mission-scope`.
*I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)*.
The substantial-substance the Father walked-out the substantial-redemption-of-Yashar'el.
The Old Testament prophetic source — Beth-lehem Ephratah as the birth-locale of the *ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.*

*Yashar'el (Israel) is my son, even my firstborn ... Let my son go, that he may serve me* — the Old Testament identification of Yashar'el (Israel) as Yahuah's (God's) firstborn son; Matthew's recapitulation reading hears this verse standing behind Hosea 11:1.

*In his days Yahudah (Judah) shall be saved, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, Yahuah Tsidkenu (THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS)* — the Messianic-source of the *tsedaqah* the hungering ones are filled with.

*Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD): And thou shalt love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart* — the Shema's whole-heart standard the dual-allegiance breaks.
The remnant-of-Yashar'el (Israel) Tanakh-pattern — only a remnant returns.

*I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of Yahuah (the LORD). The remnant of Yashar'el (Israel) shall not do iniquity* — the remnant defined by Torah-walking.
*And in that day shall the deaf hear ... the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).*
The cloud-and-fire-pillar leading Yashar'el (Israel).
The lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope.
The Yashar'el-entry-into-the-Land from-beyond-the-Yarden Tanakh-substance the King's-route recapitulates.
*Twelve gates ... names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).*
*He shall set up an ensign for the goyim (nations), and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.*
The Lukan-parallel — *I appoint unto you a kingdom ... ye shall sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).*
The Tanakh-vineyard-substance — Yashar'el (Israel) as Yahuah's vineyard.
*Sing, O daughter of Tsion (Zion) ... the King of Yashar'el (Israel), even Yahuah (the LORD), is in the midst of thee.*
**Primary Tanakh-substance.** The vineyard-of-Yahuah is the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
The 144,000 sealed of the twelve-tribes-of-Yashar'el.
*So all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved.*
*Yahuah Elohim (the Lord GOD) which gathereth the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel).*
*Take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen.*

*And in those days Yahudah (Judah) went to the house of Shem and took Tamar the daughter of Elam, the son of Shem, for a wife for his first born Er.* Jasher locates Tamar as a daughter of Shem's line — Yashar'eli (Israelite) by lineage through the Shemitic seed, not a Canaanite as the Christian read assumes. The framework reads the four women as seed-preservation markers; Jasher 45 confirms Tamar's Shemitic lineage.

Tamar's case preserved the line; Jasher walks the preservation in extra detail.

note: *And it came to pass that after Jacob died the children of Yashar’el (Israel) multiplied in the land of Egypt, and they became a great nation, and they were of one accord in heart, so that brother loved brother and every man helped his brother, and they increased abundantly and multiplied exceedingly, ten weeks of years, all the days of the life of Joseph.* (Jubilees 46:1). *When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:* (Matthew 2:14). Jubilees opens its account of Egypt with a people at rest there. After Jacob died the children of Yashar'el (Israel) multiplied, became a great nation, and loved one another all the days of Joseph; Egypt was a shelter before it was a prison. Matthew's Joseph takes the child down the same road by night, and Egypt shelters him too, until Herod is dead. The child walks the path his people walked, a sojourn in Egypt and a calling out of it, so that what happened to the nation happens again in the one who came for the nation.

*And he commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before he died that they should carry his bones with them when they went forth from the land of Egypt.* The Yoseph who went down to Egypt willed his bones be carried out; the Yahusha (Jesus) who went down to Egypt would come up by his own resurrection. The patriarchal-Yoseph's bones-out-of-Egypt is the prototype the Messianic-Yashar'el fulfills in flesh.

*And the woman conceived and bare a daughter, and she called her name Miriam, because in those days the Egyptians had embittered the lives of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).* Jasher 67 walks the Pharaoh-Mosheh-infant-slaughter narrative in fuller detail than Exodus 1 — the embittering of the children of Yashar'el, the spilling of male infant blood. The Herod-Yahusha slaughter at Matt 2:16 is the latest beat of the same antichrist-pattern.

note: *And she conceived again and bare a son and she called his name Aaron, for in the days of her conception, Pharaoh began to spill the blood of the male children of Yashar'el (Israel).* The Pharaoh-blood-of-male-children naming Jasher gives — *Pharaoh began to spill the blood of the male children.* Matthew 2:16's *slew all the children that were in Beth-lehem* is the Herod-version of the same line. Same pattern, two beats.

Matthew 2:13's angelic-Yoseph-flee-to-Egypt is the Messianic version of the same preservation pattern.

note: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* 1 Enoch 90:6 names the late-age awakening of the lambs — the white-sheep born to the white-sheep who open their eyes and see. The fishers-of-men commission at Matt 4:19 enters the same awakening-architecture: the gathering of the scattered-and-now-awakening sheep, the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) opening their eyes when the Shepherd's voice reaches them.

*But by such works have you taught your people that the just man should be merciful, and have made your children to be of a good hope that you give repentance for sins.* (Wisdom of Solomon 12:19). *But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;* (Matthew 5:44). Solomon says the Father's dealings with Yashar'el's (Israel's) enemies were themselves the lesson: by such works he taught his people that the just man should be merciful, and gave his children good hope that he gives repentance for sins. The King teaches the same lesson from the same source. Love your enemies, bless those who curse you, pray for those who persecute you, and the reason follows in the next verse: so that you may be children of your Father, who does exactly that. The mercy the children show is learned from watching the Father show it.

*Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you, so shall your sins also be forgiven when you prayest.* (Ecclesiasticus 28:2). *And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.* (Matthew 6:12). Sirach says forgive your neighbour the hurt he did you, and then your own sins will be forgiven when you pray. That is the petition Yahusha (Jesus) taught his disciples to pray, forgive us our debts as we forgive our debtors, and the condition is the same in both. Pardon received and pardon extended are named in one breath, in the same act of prayer. The disciples' prayer was not a new idea in Yashar'el (Israel); the wise had been teaching sons to pray this way for generations.

*He sheweth no mercy to a man, which is like himself: and does he ask forgiveness of his own sins?* (Ecclesiasticus 28:4). *But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.* (Matthew 6:15). Sirach presses the question down to the heart: a man shows no mercy to another man, one made like himself, and then asks forgiveness for his own sins? Yahusha (Jesus) answers it in the Sermon: if you forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours. The brother who is like you is the test. The heart that withholds mercy from him has no standing to ask it from the Father, and the wise in Yashar'el (Israel) had been saying so long before the disciples' prayer was taught.

*The fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.* (Ecclesiasticus 27:6). *Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?* (Matthew 7:16). Sirach says the fruit tells you whether the tree was dressed, and a man's speech tells you what is in his heart. Yahusha (Jesus) gives the same test for recognizing false prophets: you will know them by their fruits, because thorns do not yield grapes. The test was not new when he gave it; the wise in Yashar'el (Israel) had been teaching it for generations. What the gospel does is hand it to every disciple as the way to know a teacher, so that no one has to be fooled by the costume if he will look at the fruit.

*Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.* (Ecclesiasticus 36:11). *And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.* (Matthew 8:11). Sirach prays for all the tribes of Jacob to be gathered and given back their inheritance as from the beginning, twelve tribes and not two. Yahusha (Jesus) says many will come from east and west and sit down with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom. The many from east and west are the children of those three fathers coming home from where they were scattered, which is exactly what Sirach asked for. They are not a new people put in the seat of Yashar'el (Israel); they are the tribes of Jacob taking their own seats at their fathers' table.

*O Yahuah (God), have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Yashar'el (Israel), whom you have named your firstborn.* (Ecclesiasticus 36:12). *And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.* (Matthew 8:11). Sirach prays for mercy on the people called by the name of Yahuah (God), on Yashar'el (Israel) whom he named his firstborn. Yahusha (Jesus) says many will come from east and west and sit down with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom. The firstborn is one people, named from the beginning, and the many from east and west are that firstborn's scattered children coming to their fathers' table. The mercy Sirach asks for the firstborn is the seat Yahusha (Jesus) says they will take.

*For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.* (2 Esdras 12:34). *And when Yahusha (Jesus) departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.* (Matthew 9:27). The anointed does two things in Ezra's vision: he reproves the eagle, and he delivers the rest of the people with mercy, those pressed upon the borders, and makes them joyful until the day of judgment. The blind men ask the Son of David for exactly that, mercy. The remnant pressed at the borders are the scattered of Yashar'el (Israel), and the first work of the Messiah (Christ) toward them is mercy, as it was for the two who cried out. He saw the multitudes as sheep having no shepherd and was moved for them (Matthew 9:36).

*Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.* (2 Esdras 13:40). *But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 10:6). Ezra is told plainly who the peaceable multitude of his vision is: the ten tribes Shalmaneser carried out of their own land and over the waters, who never came back. Those are the people the King means when he sends the twelve to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel). A sheep is lost when it has wandered where the shepherd cannot see it, and the northern house had been lost in another land for seven centuries by the time Yahusha (Jesus) spoke these words. The mission of the twelve was aimed at the same body Ezra was shown.

*But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt, That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.* (2 Esdras 13:41–42). *But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 10:6). The tribes did not simply vanish into the heathen. Ezra is told they took counsel to leave the multitude and go further out, into a country where no one lived, so that they could keep the statutes they had never kept in their own land. The carrying away became, for a remnant of them, a going out to keep Torah. Centuries later the King sends the twelve to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), the same body, in the lands it went out to. The commandments they carried into the far country are what the sheep are being called back to, and Yahusha (Jesus) sends his messengers after them rather than waiting for them to find the way home alone.

*The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.* (2 Esdras 13:47). *But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Yashar'el (Israel), till the Son of Adam be come.* (Matthew 10:23). The Most High stayed the river once so the tribes could cross out, and Ezra is promised he will stay it again so they can cross back, in the latter time. That return is the end of the story the vision tells. Yahusha (Jesus) tells the twelve they will not finish going over the cities of Yashar'el (Israel) before the Son of Adam comes; the work he sends them on is not completed in their lifetime but runs until his coming. Set together, the two say the same thing: the going after the lost sheep and the gathering of the ten tribes are one work, begun with the sending and finished when the Highest opens the way home and the King returns.

*And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.* (Tobit 13:5). *But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 10:6). Tobit lays out the whole order in one breath: Yahuah (God) scourges his people for their iniquities, has mercy again, and gathers them out of all the nations he scattered them into. The scourge was the scattering. The mercy is the gathering. When Yahusha (Jesus) sends the twelve, he points them at the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), the very people Tobit said would be gathered, and the sending is that mercy beginning to move. The gathering Tobit prayed for as a thing still to come is the mission the King commissions.

*Confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for he has scattered us among them. There declare his greatness, and extol him before all the living: for he is our Elohim (God), and he is Yahuah (God) our Father for ever.* (Tobit 13:3–4). *Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.* (Matthew 10:32). Tobit sings this from the land of the captivity, and the instruction is not to hide among the Gentiles but to confess Yahuah (God) in front of them, to declare his greatness in the very places he scattered his children into. Yahusha (Jesus) is sending the twelve to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) in this same chapter, and he gives them the same charge with a promise attached: confess me before men, and I will confess you before my Father. The scattered confess him where they were scattered, and the King names them before the Father. The confession Tobit called for and the confession Yahusha (Jesus) rewards are one confession, made by the same scattered people in the same territories.

*And that again Yahuah (God) will have mercy on them, and bring them again into the land, where they shall build a temple, but not like to the first, until the time of that age be fulfilled; and afterward they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Jerusalem gloriously, and the house of Yahuah (God) shall be built in it for ever with a glorious building, as the prophets have spoken thereof.* (Tobit 14:5). *But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Yashar'el (Israel), till the Son of Adam be come.* (Matthew 10:23). Tobit, dying, tells his son there will be two returns, not one. First a return to the land and a temple not like the first, which is the house Zerubbabel, Ezra, and Nehemiah raised after Babylon, a return of Yahudah (Judah) only. Then, after the time of that age is fulfilled, a return from all places of the captivity, Jerusalem built gloriously and the house of Yahuah (God) built in it for ever, as the prophets spoke. That second return has not happened. Between the two stands the work Yahusha (Jesus) sends the twelve into, and he tells them it will not be finished before the Son of Adam comes. The mission to the cities of Yashar'el (Israel) runs through this age toward the return Tobit saw at the end of it.

*For he had heard in Phoenicia that certain of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), about the time of the Assyrian captivity, had escaped by sea to "the isles afar off," as spoken by the prophet, and called by the Romans, Britain.* Sonnini Acts 29:2 names Paul's motivation for the Spain-and-Britain journey: the scattered children of Yashar'el (Israel) had fled by sea at the time of the Assyrian captivity to the isles afar off (the prophetic-language of Isaiah 49:1, Jeremiah 31:10). Matt 10:6's lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) names the same body Sonnini Acts 29 has Paul going FAR HENCE to gather — the apostolic-mission carrying the Matt 10 commission to the actual territories of the Assyrian-dispersion remnant. The wisdom-stream of the restored *Acts of Paul* extension confirms the gathering-of-the-scattered-seed thesis the Matthew commission inaugurates.

*And Yahuah (Lord) commanded the gospel to be preached far hence to the Gentiles, and to the lost sheep of the House of Yashar'el (Israel).* Sonnini Acts 29:3 is the direct verbal-anchor for Matt 10:6's mission-scope in the apostolic-extension territory: the same *lost sheep of the House of Yashar'el (Israel)* phrase the King uses at Matt 10:6 (and at Matt 15:24) is the very phrase the restored Sonnini chapter names as Yahuah (the LORD)'s commissioning of Paul's far-hence mission. The Matt 10:5-6 commission scope and the Sonnini Acts 29:3 commission scope are identical — one to the disciples in the immediate region of Galilee, the other to Paul in the far-hence territories of the dispersion-isles. Both are the same gathering of the same scattered seed.

*And it came to pass that certain of the Druids came unto Paul privately, and showed by their rites and ceremonies they were descended from the Yahudim (Jews) which escaped from bondage in the land of Egypt, and the apostle believed these things, and he gave them the kiss of peace.* Sonnini Acts 29:13 names the apostolic-recognition of the scattered-seed lineage in the British territories — the Druids whose rites and ceremonies disclosed Yashar'el-itish (Israel-itish) descent received the kiss of peace from Paul. The Matt 10:23 standing-mission-across-centuries reaches the territories the wisdom-stream had named as the dispersion-destinations; the gathering finds the scattered where they have been driven. Paul's reception of the Druid-disclosure is the apostolic-mission walking the Matt 10 architecture in the far-hence territories the King had named at Matt 10:23 as still-to-be-traversed.

*Who were ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the judgment of Yahuah (God), before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.* (Ecclesiasticus 48:10). *And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.* (Matthew 11:14). When Yahusha (Jesus) says John is the Elias who was to come, he is pointing at a job description everyone in the crowd knew. Sirach had written it out: Elijah is ordained to reprove, to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob. All of Jacob, all twelve tribes, the scattered house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) together. John began that work at the Jordan; the full restoring of the tribes waits on the great and dreadful day Malachi set it beside (Malachi 4:5). *If ye will receive it* is the hard part, because receiving it means receiving that the gathering of a scattered people is what Elijah comes to do.

*Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.* (1 Maccabees 2:58). *And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.* (Matthew 11:14). Mattathias remembers Elijah (Elias) for one thing: he was zealous and fervent for the law, and he was taken up into heaven. That is how the faithful in Yashar'el (Israel) remembered him, as the man who stood for the commandments of Yahuah (God) against a kingdom that had traded them for Baal. When Yahusha (Jesus) says of John, this is Elijah (Elias) which was for to come, the likeness is that same zeal: John in the wilderness calling the leadership a generation of vipers, John in prison for telling Herod his marriage was unlawful. Elijah's zeal for the law is what Malachi promised would come before the great day, and it came first in John.

*He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.* (Baruch 3:36). *The Son of Adam came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.* (Matthew 11:19). Baruch says the whole way of knowledge was found out by Elohim (God) and then given, not to the world at large but to Jacob his servant and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved. Wisdom has a people she was given to. Yahusha (Jesus), reproached for eating with publicans and sinners, says wisdom is justified of her children: the ones who recognize her are her own. The children of wisdom in Matthew 11 are the covenant seed Baruch names, the people the knowledge was given to, and when the one who gave it stood among them in flesh they knew his voice even when the leaders did not. Her children are the proof she was given to Jacob.

*Reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away your face from a poor man.* (Ecclesiasticus 4:4). *A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.* (Matthew 12:20). Sirach is describing a face that stays turned toward the one in need, and Matthew 12:20 describes the Messiah's: a bruised reed he will not break, smoking flax he will not quench. The supplication of the afflicted is the bruised reed, and the poor man at the door is the smoking flax, easy to snap and easy to snuff. What Sirach asked of every son of Yashar'el (Israel), Yahusha (Jesus) did. A religious system that turns its face from the afflicted has abandoned the counsel and parted ways with the Messiah in the same motion.

*And there will be great wrath from Yahuah (God) against the children of Yashar’el (Israel), because they have forsaken His covenant and turned aside from His word, and provoked and blasphemed, inasmuch as they do not observe the ordinance of this law; for they have treated their members like the nations, so that they may be removed and rooted out of the land. And there will no more be pardon or forgiveness to them so that there should be forgiveness and pardon for all the sin of this eternal error.* (Jubilees 15:34). *Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.* (Matthew 12:31). Jubilees says a thing most readers do not expect from the book of the covenant: there is a sin for which there will no more be pardon. It is not a slip or a weakness. It is the children of Yashar'el (Israel) knowing the ordinance, forsaking the covenant on purpose, and treating the sign in their own flesh the way the nations do. Yahusha (Jesus) draws the same line in Matthew: every manner of sin and blasphemy can be forgiven, but the one who has watched the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) at work and called it something else has stepped past the place where forgiveness reaches. Both texts describe the same posture, a deliberate turning aside from what one has plainly seen, and both say the same thing about where it ends.

*Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.* (Wisdom of Solomon 16:20). *And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.* (Matthew 14:19). Bread from heaven, prepared without their labour, was how the Father fed his own people in the wilderness. On the grass in a desert place Yahusha (Jesus) looks up to heaven, blesses, breaks, and the loaves go out through the disciples' hands to a multitude that brought nothing but its hunger. The same hand that sent the manna is feeding Yashar'el (Israel) again, and John's account of this same meal ends with him saying who the bread is: *I am the bread of life* (John 6:35).

*Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.* (Ecclesiasticus 24:19). *And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.* (Matthew 14:20). Wisdom says come and fill yourselves with my fruits, and in the desert place Yahusha (Jesus) did exactly that: the multitude came to him, they ate, and they were filled. He is the Wisdom of Ecclesiasticus 24 feeding her children with her own hand, and the invitation of Matthew 11:28, *come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden*, is the same mouth speaking. Twelve baskets were left over, one for every tribe of Yashar'el (Israel), and the leftover says the feeding was never meant for that hillside alone. The scattered children of Wisdom will be gathered and fed the same way.

*Have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (God) of all, and behold us:* (Ecclesiasticus 36:1). *But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24). Sirach opens his great prayer with a cry for mercy to the Elohim (God) of all, and the prayer goes on to ask that all the tribes of Jacob be gathered and inherited as from the beginning. Yahusha (Jesus) says he was not sent but to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel). The one being asked for mercy in Sirach's prayer is the one who answered it in person, sent to the very scattered house the prayer was about. Behold us, Sirach prays; the Shepherd came looking for the sheep.

*Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.* (Ecclesiasticus 36:11). *But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24). Sirach prays for the gathering of all the tribes of Jacob, back into the inheritance as from the beginning. Yahusha (Jesus) says he was sent to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel). The prayer and the mission have the same object: not Yahudah (Judah) alone, who had a temple and a land, but the whole house that had been scattered and lost among the nations. The prophets promised it, Sirach prayed it, and the King came for it.

*Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.* (2 Esdras 13:40). *But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24). When the woman of Canaan pressed him, Yahusha (Jesus) named the scope of his sending: the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) — and she, who heard the Shepherd and would not be turned away, was one of them. Ezra had already been shown who that house is, the ten tribes Shalmaneser led away captive over the waters into another land, who never returned. The lost sheep were not a figure of speech; they were a people with a date, a captor, and a direction of travel, the same carrying away the book of Kings records (2 Kings 17:6). The King was sent to them, and the prophets who promised their gathering (Jeremiah 31; Ezekiel 37) were speaking of the same people.

*But those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders.* (2 Esdras 13:48). *But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24). The vision does not forget the ones who never left. After the ten tribes come home, Ezra is told that those left behind of his people are the ones found within the borders of the land, the remnant of Yahudah (Judah) that stayed. When Yahusha (Jesus) says he was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), his sending reaches both of these: the multitudes of Galilee and Yahudah (Judah) he walked among inside the borders, and the scattered house beyond the waters his apostles would be sent after. The house of Yashar'el (Israel) is both of them, the ones who stayed and the ones who were carried, and the King's mission is to the whole house.

*And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.* (Tobit 13:5). *But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24). Tobit names who gets gathered and from where: the people Yahuah (God) scourged and scattered, brought back out of all the nations. Ezekiel had said the same, *I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side* (Ezekiel 37:21). When Yahusha (Jesus) says he is not sent but to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), he is stating the scope of that gathering, not narrowing his mercy. He said it to the woman of Canaan, and she was not turned away; the sheep hear the Shepherd's voice wherever the scattering has carried them, and the hearing shows who they are. The mission to the lost sheep is the mercy Tobit said would follow the scourge.

*For Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar’el (Israel) to be His people.* (Jubilees 15:30). *And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Adonai (Lord), thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.* (Matthew 15:22). Not every child of Abraham is the chosen seed. Jubilees says it flat: Ishmael, his sons, his brothers, Esau, Yahuah (God) did not bring them near, though they were Abraham's children; He chose Yashar'el (Israel) to be His people. The woman crying *Son of David* on the coast of Tyre and Sidon is not standing outside that choice. Yahusha (Jesus) says *I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Matthew 15:24) and then heals her daughter, which means she is one of those lost sheep. Canaan was the ground of her exile, the merchant coast where the divorced northern house was swallowed up among the Gentiles (Hosea 8:8), not a verdict on her blood. She knew the Shepherd's voice and called him by David's name because she was a sheep before she ever heard him. The line Jubilees draws is kept; what the story shows is that the chosen seed had been scattered to places their brothers would never have looked.

*And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.* (Jubilees 15:31). *But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.* (Matthew 15:26). Jubilees explains the difference between the children and the dogs. Many nations and many peoples are all His, but over them He set spirits in authority, and those spirits lead them astray; Yashar'el (Israel) He sanctified and gathered out from among all the children of men to rule Himself. Moses sang the same thing: *when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel). For the LORD’S portion is his people* (Deuteronomy 32:8–9). The woman on the coast of Canaan lives among the people under those spirits, and her daughter is vexed with a devil, but when she calls him *Son of David* and keeps asking, she shows she is not one of theirs. Yahusha (Jesus) says the bread is the children's, and then gives it to her, because she is a child of the household the Father rules directly, a lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) scattered into the territory of the spirits (Matthew 15:24, 28).

*But over Yashar’el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler, and He will preserve them and require them at the hand of His angels and His spirits, and at the hand of all His powers in order that He may preserve them and bless them, and that they may be His and He may be theirs from henceforth for ever.* (Jubilees 15:32). *But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.* (Matthew 15:26). Over Yashar'el (Israel) no angel and no spirit: He alone is their ruler, and He keeps them Himself and requires them at the hand of every power. That is why Yahusha (Jesus) says he was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) (Matthew 15:24). The Shepherd who said through Ezekiel *I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out* (Ezekiel 34:11) had come to do it in person. The woman on the coast of Canaan is of that flock, a daughter of the divorced northern house living in the land of her scattering, and the Shepherd who was sent only to the lost sheep found one of them there. He says the bread is for the children, she answers as a child who knows whose table it is, and he gives it to her (Matthew 15:28). The line is kept; she was on the inside of it all along, and the hearing revealed it.

*And (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations.* (Jubilees 16:17). *But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.* (Matthew 15:26). Abraham's other sons became nations and are reckoned with the nations; from Isaac comes one holy seed that is not reckoned among them. Paul says it the same way: *they are not all Yashar'el (Israel), which are of Yashar'el (Israel) ... In Isaac shall thy seed be called* (Romans 9:6–7). Children and dogs at the table is the same distinction. The seed of promise has a name and a line, and Yahusha (Jesus) does not pretend otherwise; he tells her the bread is the children's. But he was sent to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) (Matthew 15:24), and the coast of Tyre and Sidon was where the divorced northern house had been swallowed up among the Gentiles (Hosea 8:8). When she answers as one who knows the Master's table and he gives her the bread, he is not crossing the line; he is finding a child of Isaac's holy seed on the far side of her exile.

*And I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years: but the year thereof have I not told you till you enter the land which you are to possess.* (Jubilees 50:2). *And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.* (Matthew 15:37). Jubilees counts the land's rest in sevens: Sabbaths of years, and the jubilee at the end of seven sevens, as Moses laid it out, *seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years* (Leviticus 25:8). The two feedings count in the two numbers of Yashar'el (Israel): twelve baskets for the twelve tribes (Matthew 14:20), seven baskets for the Sabbath and the jubilee. A crowd fed and filled with seven baskets over is a picture of the rest the land was promised: enough, more than enough, and the count of the week on top. The bread was real, and so was the number.

*Wherefore I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day, and one week and two years and there are yet forty years to come (lit. "distant for learning the commandments of Yahuah (God), until they pass over into the land of Canaan, crossing the Jordan to the west.* (Jubilees 50:4). *And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.* (Matthew 15:37). Jubilees counts forty-nine jubilees from Adam to the border of the land, seven sevens of jubilees, with the fiftieth opening as Yashar'el (Israel) crosses Jordan. Seven is the number this book counts the world's history in. When Yahusha (Jesus) feeds the crowd and seven baskets remain, the number lands on ears trained by that count. He had already stood in Nazareth and read *the acceptable year of Yahuah (Lord)* and told them *this day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears* (Luke 4:19, 21); the jubilee had a face. The seven baskets are the full measure left over when the jubilee is proclaimed.

*Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.* (Ecclesiasticus 17:11). *And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, Elohim (God): but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.* (Matthew 19:17). Sirach calls the law a law of life, given for an heritage along with knowledge. Yahusha (Jesus) tells the young man that if he would enter into life he should keep the commandments. The law of life and entering into life are the same road. Moses set life and good before Yashar'el (Israel) in the commandments, Sirach calls that inheritance by its name, and the King does not amend it when the question is put to him directly.

*And after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations, and they will seek Me, so that I shall be found of them, when they seek Me with all their heart and with all their soul.* (Jubilees 1:15). *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 19:28). Twelve thrones judging twelve tribes means twelve tribes will be there to be judged. Jubilees says how they get there: they turn to Him from among the nations with all their heart, and He gathers them from among all the nations. That is Ezekiel's two sticks made one, and Isaiah's *outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)* and *dispersed of Yahudah (Judah)* gathered *from the four corners of the earth* (Isaiah 11:12). The regeneration Yahusha (Jesus) speaks of is a gathered people of Jacob's blood seated under Jacob's sons' names, not a church that has renamed itself Yashar'el (Israel). The scattering was real, the gathering is real, and the thrones are for real tribes.

*And they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob; They will speak the word of Yahuah (God) in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness. And they will declare My ways to Jacob And My paths to Yashar’el (Israel). The blessing of Yahuah (God) will be given in their mouths To bless all the seed of the beloved.* (Jubilees 31:15). *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 19:28). Isaac's blessing on Levi at Bethel is a blessing of judgeship: princes and judges and chiefs over all the seed of Jacob's sons, speaking the word of Yahuah (God) and declaring His ways to Jacob. Yahusha (Jesus) seats twelve men on twelve thrones over the same seed. Judging in Yashar'el (Israel) was never only a courtroom; *Yahuah (LORD) raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them* (Judges 2:16). What Levi was blessed to carry at the altar, the twelve are given to carry at the throne, and the people under them are still the seed of the sons of Jacob.

*Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.* (Ecclesiasticus 36:11). *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 19:28). Sirach prays for all the tribes of Jacob to be gathered and inherited as from the beginning. Yahusha (Jesus) tells the twelve that in the regeneration, when the Son of Adam sits on the throne of his glory, they will sit on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel). Twelve thrones for twelve tribes means the twelve tribes are there to be judged: gathered, whole, as from the beginning. What Sirach asked for in prayer the King states as the shape of the kingdom when it comes.

*They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Elohim (God) shall reign for ever.* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:8). *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 19:28). Wisdom says the righteous shall judge the nations; Yahusha (Jesus) tells the twelve they shall sit on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel). These are two views of one kingdom. The gathered twelve tribes sit under the apostles' thrones, and that gathered people is the kingdom of priests the Father promised at Sinai — *ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests* (Exodus 19:6) — who judge and teach the nations left alive in the reign. The priesthood toward the nations begins when the kingdom is set up, not before. Wisdom saw the outer ring; the King named the inner one.

*There were twelve harts feeding: and the nine were (first) dispersed over all the earth, and likewise also the three.* Testaments XII Joseph 15 (chapter 86 in the corpus enumeration) verse 2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the twelve-harts-feeding-then-dispersed substance — the same scattering-and-restoration-of-the-twelve-tribes architecture the King at Matt 19:28's *judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* presupposes-as-the-completed-gathering-architecture. The framework reads the verse against the King's-statement. The Joseph-testament-substance names the substance directly: twelve-harts (the twelve-tribes) feeding-together-originally, then-dispersed (the nine = the ten-northern-tribes; the three = the southern-house-substance), the substance the prophets had named at Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 37:15-22's two-sticks-becoming-one. The substance the King-states at Matt 19:28 is the gathering-and-judging-substance the wisdom-stream-Joseph-testament had named the architecture-for. The wisdom-stream, the Tanakh-prophets, and the King's-mouth all hold the same architecture: twelve-tribes-dispersed-and-gathered-and-judged-by-twelve-apostles-at-the-consummated-substance. The framework reads in framework-substance per Red Line #11 — the twelve-tribes are LITERAL twelve-tribes, the paternal-blood remnant the Father-promised-through-the-prophets-and-now-states-at-the-King's-mouth. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

*So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* (Ecclesiasticus 24:8). *For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.* (Matthew 20:1). Wisdom was commanded by the Creator to pitch her tent in Jacob and take her inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel). Isaiah had already said that the vineyard of Yahuah (God) is the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and Jeremiah mourned the pastors who destroyed it. When Yahusha (Jesus) opens the parable with a householder hiring labourers into his vineyard, that is the vineyard he means — the covenant people the Father planted and in whom Wisdom made her dwelling. The householder is the Father, and the labourers are the ones he calls into it through the hours of the day.

*And I took root in an honourable people, even in the portion of the inheritance of Yahuah (God).* (Ecclesiasticus 24:12). *For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.* (Matthew 20:1). Wisdom says she took root in an honourable people, in the portion that is Yahuah's (God's) own inheritance. That people is the vineyard of the parable — the householder's own ground, into which he goes out to hire labourers through the day. The vineyard is Yashar'el (Israel), and so are the labourers called into it, whether called early or late: the covenant line from Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and the children of that line who grew up scattered among the nations and are being called home. The honourable people Wisdom rooted in is the inheritance the Father is still gathering.

*And said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine:* (2 Esdras 5:23). *For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.* (Matthew 20:1). Ezra, praying, names what the Most High did with the whole earth: out of every wood and every tree he chose one vine. When Yahusha (Jesus) opens the parable of the labourers, the householder's vineyard is not a new field; it is that one vine, the vineyard Isaiah had already named as the house of Yashar'el (Israel) (Isaiah 5:7). Labourers are hired into it at different hours, but the vineyard itself was chosen long before the morning began. Whoever is brought in at the eleventh hour is brought into that same vineyard, not into a different one planted beside it.

*And after these things shall a star arise to you from Jacob in peace.* Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 37:5 (Testament of Levi 18 / Testament of Yahudah (Judah) 24 cluster, depending on the recension-positioning the parsed-text preserves) names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the star-from-Ya'aqov (Jacob) substance — the Davidic-Messianic credential the marginalized two-blind-men at Yericho (Jericho) recognize at Matt 20:30's *thou Son of David, have mercy on us.* The framework reads the verse in continuity with Bamidbar (Numbers) 24:17's *there shall come a Star out of Ya'aqov (Jacob), and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)* the prophet Bila'am (Balaam) had carried at the pre-entry-to-the-Land vision. The wisdom-stream and the Tanakh-prophetic-witness cohere — the star-from-Ya'aqov (Jacob) substance is the same Davidic-Messianic credential the marginalized-substance walks-into-recognizing at the gospel-pivot.

*And from it shall grow up the rod of righteousness unto the Gentiles, To judge and to save all that call upon Yahuah (Lord).* Testament of Yahudah (Judah) ch 15 v.6 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the rod-of-righteousness substance the Messianic-King carries-out — the *judge and save all that call upon Yahuah* substance the framework reads carefully. The framework reads the verse against Matt 21:5's King-coming-to-his-city substance. The substance the wisdom-stream names at *all that call upon Yahuah (Lord)* is the substance the King-walks at the marginalized-substance crying *Son of David* (Matt 9:27, 15:22, 20:30-31) now-walked-by-the-multitudes at the entry-substance; the *Gentiles* in the wisdom-stream-language carries the same wisdom-stream-convention as Paul's-letters address — the substance is NOT the categorical-three-categories-nations-as-collective replacing-Yashar'el (Israel) but the substance of the scattered-seed-of-Yashar'el-living-as-Gentiles-among-the-nations per Red Line #7's scattered-seed-coming-home substance + Red Line #11's wild-olive-substance of the descendants-of-the-broken-off-who-hear-when-the-Shepherd-calls. The substance the wisdom-stream had named is the substance the gospel walks-out at the entry.

*For though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out.* (Wisdom of Solomon 4:4). *And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.* (Matthew 21:19). Wisdom describes the brood of the ungodly as branches that flourish for a while with nothing under them; the wind shakes them and finally roots them out. Yahusha (Jesus) came to a fig tree in full leaf, found no fruit, and it withered. Leaves without fruit is the same picture as branches without roots — a show of life with nothing feeding it. The tree stands for the religious leadership of that day, which had the look of the covenant and none of its fruit; it does not stand for the people of Yashar'el (Israel) as a whole. What flourishes without a root does not stand when the wind comes.

*The imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing.* (Wisdom of Solomon 4:5). *And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.* (Matthew 21:19). Wisdom is describing branches that flourish for a season, bear nothing worth eating, and are broken off. The fig tree the King met on the road the morning after he cleansed the Temple was all leaves and no fruit, and he spoke its end on the spot. The tree was not the people of Yashar'el (Israel); it was the leadership standing in that Temple with every show of foliage and nothing to feed anyone, the same men he answers with seven woes in Matthew 23 before the week is out. The test he had already given his disciples was fruit, not leaves (Matthew 7:16), and Solomon had written the same verdict long before.

thread:magnificat-as-hannah-pattern-and-the-gathering-song-of-the-daughter-of-yasharel | *And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.* The Tehillim (Psalm) 103:17 — *the mercy of Yahuah (the LORD) is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him* — is the substance Miriam is singing. The mercy is generational; the gathering is the keeping of mercy from the fathers to the children.

thread:magnificat-as-hannah-pattern-and-the-gathering-song-of-the-daughter-of-yasharel | *For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.* Miriam names the same holy-Name-of-Yahuah Tehillim (Psalm) 111:9 names — *holy and reverend is his name.* The third-commandment weight of the Name is honored in the moment the Name's own son is conceived.

thread:magnificat-as-hannah-pattern-and-the-gathering-song-of-the-daughter-of-yasharel | *For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden.* The *low estate* echoes Channah (Hannah)'s vow at 1 Samuel 1:11 — *if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid.* The same Father who looked on Channah looks on Miriam; the same handmaiden-substance carries forward.

thread:magnificat-as-hannah-pattern-and-the-gathering-song-of-the-daughter-of-yasharel | *And Miriam (Mary) said, My soul doth magnify Yahuah (the Lord), and my spirit hath rejoiced in Elohim (God) my Saviour.* Miriam's opening words echo Channah (Hannah)'s *My heart rejoiceth in Yahuah (the LORD), mine horn is exalted in Yahuah (the LORD)* — the same daughter-of-Yashar'el (Israel)'s exultation in the answering of the barren-womb prayer, here applied to the womb that carries the Formed-Son.

thread:benedictus-as-priestly-witness-to-the-davidic-horn-and-the-avraham-oath | *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of Yashar'el (Israel); for he hath visited and redeemed his people.* The blessing-formula echoes Tehillim (Psalm) 41:13 — *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting.* The visitation-and-redemption is the prophetic-substance Zecharyah (Zacharias) names from the priestly altar.

thread:simeon-and-anna-as-two-witnesses-at-the-presentation-light-glory-and-the-sword | *Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Yashar'el (Israel); and for a sign which shall be spoken against.* Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 8:14 — *And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Yashar'el (Israel)* — is the falling-and-rising substance directly. The Stone-of-Stumbling Tehillim (Psalm) 118:22 substance is named over the infant Shimon (Simeon) holds.

thread:simeon-and-anna-as-two-witnesses-at-the-presentation-light-glory-and-the-sword | *Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people; a light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Yashar'el (Israel).* Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 49:6 — *I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth* — is the Servant-Song substance directly. The *Gentiles* (Greek *ethnē*) are the territories of the scattered; the light reaches the scattered through reaching the territories that contain them. The *glory of thy people Yashar'el* names the same twelve-tribe-seed-of-promise the prophets named — not a metaphorical Yashar'el.

thread:simeon-and-anna-as-two-witnesses-at-the-presentation-light-glory-and-the-sword | *And the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Yashar'el (Israel).* The *consolation of Yashar'el* echoes Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 40:1 — *Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your Elohim (God).* Shimon (Simeon) is waiting for the comforting-of-the-people Yeshayahu 40 names — the gathering that begins with the voice-in-the-wilderness.

thread:nazareth-scroll-the-acceptable-year-stopped-mid-verse-and-the-individual-mercy-contrast-cases | *And many lepers were in Yashar'el (Israel) in the time of Eliseus (Elisha) the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.* 2 Melakhim (Kings) 5:14 — *Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Yarden (Jordan), according to the saying of the man of Elohim (God): and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean* — is the individual-mercy case for the Syrian commander. Naaman receives healing without absorption; the contrast case proves the directional non-symmetry of the seed-mechanism.

thread:luke-3-political-and-priestly-backdrop-as-the-prophetic-clock | *And Herod being tetrarch of Galiyl (Galilee).* Herod Antipas, son of the infant-slaughter Herod of Matthew 2, sits in Galiyl as the herod-as-edomite-usurper. Bamidbar (Numbers) 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Ya'aqov (Jacob), and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)... and shall smite the corners of Moav (Moab), and destroy all the children of Sheth* — the legitimate sceptre-from-Yashar'el is the substance the Edomite-usurper-pattern stands against.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *No man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.* The Formless-Father / Formed-Son revelation-economy named in the Markan / Matthean / Lukan doublet, paired with the Yochanan (John) 10:14-15 *I know my sheep, and am known of mine* — the same architecture of recognition running through every chapter.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.* The synoptic-doublet of Matthew 11:25-27 lands in Luke's seventy-commissioning context — the cause-and-effect-of-hearing diagnostic the framework names: *thou hast hid* and *hast revealed* are sovereign-election-precedes-hearing language. Lord here is vocative-to-the-Father (preserve as *Lord* per S182 NT-Lord rule).

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy.* The serpent-seed-war from Bereshit (Genesis) 3:15 walks forward — the seventy are handed authority over the serpent-administration that has held the nations since the dispersion.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *I beheld ha-satan (Satan) as lightning fall from heaven.* The Watcher-rebellion answer the King names in seven words; ties to Revelation 12:7-9 where the dragon and his angels are cast out. The seventy's territory-by-territory undoing of unclean-spirit administration IS the working-out of the lightning-fall the King saw.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you.* The shake-the-dust-off rejection-response from Mosheh's (Moses's) wilderness law walking into the seventy's commission — we do not chase the nations into a worship they will not give per the framework's reading.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *Heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of Elohim (God) is come nigh unto you.* The seventy carry the same charge as the Twelve of Matthew 10 / Luke 9 — heal, proclaim. The Twelve correspond to the tribes; the seventy correspond to the elders; together the constitutional shape of Yashar'el is sent out before the King.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them.* The seventy elders Mosheh (Moses) appoints under Yahuah's (the LORD's) own instruction — the seventy-Yashar'el structure repeating itself in the wilderness administration. The seventy sent out is the same Yashar'el-administrative-seventy walking into the Yashar'el-territory of the seventy nations.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *And all the souls that came out of the loins of Ya'aqov (Jacob) were seventy souls.* The Shemot (Exodus) confirmation of the seventy-house-of-Ya'aqov number.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *All the souls of the house of Ya'aqov (Jacob), which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.* The seventy-sons-of-Yashar'el at the entry into Egypt is the covenant-side mirror to the seventy-nations of Bereshit (Genesis) 10. The seventy sent out is Yashar'el's twelve-tribe-and-seventy-elder constitution at the start of the gathering.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).* Devarim (Deuteronomy) 32:8 names the seventy-nations / seventy-sons-of-Yashar'el mirror (older Hebrew witness: *according to the number of the sons of Elohim*) — the seventy-fold register the King's seventy sent out walks.

thread:the-seventy-sent-out-as-yasharel-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations | *Yahuah (the Lord) appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two.* The number traces directly to Bereshit (Genesis) 10:32's Table of Nations: *These are the families of the sons of Noach (Noah), after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.* The Genesis 10 list contains seventy peoples — the numbering of the Most High at the dispersion. The King's seventy sent out is a one-for-one Yashar'el-contingent answer.

thread:good-samaritan-as-scattered-northern-witness-not-gentile-inclusion-paradigm | *But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was.* The Samaritans were the mixed-population the Assyrian king resettled in the territory of the divorced northern kingdom — *And the king of Assyria brought men from Bavel (Babylon), and from Cuthah... and placed them in the cities of Shomron (Samaria) instead of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).* The territory the Samaritan walks in is the territory of the scattered northern tribes, not a Gentile region in the inclusion-gospel sense.

thread:martha-and-mary-the-one-thing-needful-the-word-heard | *Sat at Yahusha's (Jesus's) feet, and heard his word.* The hearing-at-the-feet is the Shema-posture: *Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), Yahuah (LORD) is one. And thou shalt love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart.* Hearing is the Torah's own first verb; Mary walks it.

thread:daughter-of-avraham-bent-over-eighteen-years-and-the-shabbat-loosing-of-the-covenant-bound | *So the children of Yashar'el (Israel) served Eglon the king of Moav (Moab) eighteen years* — the eighteen-year bondage as the recurring covenant-oppression duration. The bent-over woman's eighteen years carries the same compressed-witness to the covenant-people-bound-by-the-enemy substance.

thread:the-great-supper-and-the-bidden-who-refuse-and-the-gathering-from-highways-and-hedges | *That blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in* — *the fulness* (plērōma) is the same *that my house may be filled* substance. Paul reading the gathering forward — NOT the categorical-Gentile-inclusion completion the inherited reading collapses it into. The fulness is the full-number of the scattered seed gathered home from the territories of dispersion; when that gathering is complete, the *until* lands.

thread:the-great-supper-and-the-bidden-who-refuse-and-the-gathering-from-highways-and-hedges | *Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land* — the highways-and-hedges gathering at Luke 14:23 is the prophetic-gathering of the scattered seed from the territories of dispersion. Same substance.

thread:lost-coin-the-recovery-of-what-was-always-the-kings-image-bearing-property | *Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)* — the recovery-of-what-was-always-covenant the lost-coin parable carries. The Lo-Ammi-reversal of Hoshea (Hosea) 1:10 is the substance of the woman's rejoicing when the coin is found.

thread:prodigal-son-and-the-elder-brother-the-two-house-gathering-of-ephraim-and-yahudah | *When Yashar'el (Israel) was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt... I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms... I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love* (Hoshea/Hosea 11:1-4) — the father-running-to-meet-the-returning-son carries the same drawing-with-cords-of-love substance. The Father's pursuit of the scattered house is the architecture under the parable.

thread:prodigal-son-and-the-elder-brother-the-two-house-gathering-of-ephraim-and-yahudah | *How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Yashar'el (Israel)? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Tsevoim (Zeboim)? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together* — the father's *had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him* (Luke 15:20) is the Hoshea (Hosea) 11:8 compassion-language of the Father over Ephraim in flesh.

thread:pharisee-and-publican-the-flesh-credential-vs-mercy-contrast-and-the-judaizer-architecture-in-parable-form | *If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel), of the tribe of Binyamin (Benjamin)... But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for HaMashiach (Christ)* — Paul's own walking-away-from-the-Pharisee-posture in his own voice. The flesh-credentials he had, counted loss when the standing-test landed.

thread:times-of-the-gentiles-and-the-nations-as-territorial-occupier-of-yerushalayim | Romans 11:25's *blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in* names the corresponding *until* of the gathering — Paul reading the same *times of the Gentiles* the King names. NOT Christian-Gentile-inclusion completion; the gathering-of-the-scattered-from-the-nations completion. The *plērōma* is the full-number of the scattered seed gathered home from the territories of dispersion; when that gathering is complete, the *until* lands.

thread:times-of-the-gentiles-and-the-nations-as-territorial-occupier-of-yerushalayim | The Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 39:23 *the house of Yashar'el (Israel) went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword* names the captive-and-scattered substance the *led away captive into all nations* carries.

thread:scattered-seed-gathering | The angel's word over Yochanan (John) — *and many of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall he turn to Yahuah (the Lord) their Elohim (God)* — is the Hoshea (Hosea) 1:10 ingathering already at the door. The Lo-Ammi to sons-of-the-living-Elohim turn begins with the Eliyahu-pattern (Elijah-pattern) prophet's voice in the wilderness. Many — not all — because the post-harvest sifting is still future; the turning is the begin of the gathering, not the end of it.

thread:the-seed-of-promise-is-singular-paternal | *He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) shall give unto him the throne of his father David: and he shall reign over the house of Ya'aqov (Jacob) for ever.* The angel's word is the 2 Samuel 7 Davidic promise landing on the paternal-seed-singular — *to thy seed, which is HaMashiach (Christ).* The throne goes to ONE seed in the line of David, not to a metaphorical extension. The *house of Ya'aqov* names all twelve tribes, not a metaphorical Yashar'el (Israel).

thread:word-made-flesh-formed-of-the-formless | *That holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of Elohim (God).* The Formed-one drawn from the Formless takes flesh in the womb of a daughter-of-Yashar'el (Israel). The same Word of Yochanan (John) 1:14 who *dwelt among us* is here being conceived. The angel's word *the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee* is the Formless-Father's act of bringing forth the Formed-Son into flesh by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).

thread:scattered-seed-gathering | Miriam (Mary)'s Magnificat (Luke 1:46-55) carries the scattered-seed-gathering substance in song-form. The closing *He hath holpen his servant Yashar'el (Israel), in remembrance of his mercy; as he spake to our fathers, to Avraham (Abraham), and to his seed for ever* (vv.54-55) IS the Hoshea (Hosea) 1:10 reversal-architecture: the gathering is the keeping of the Avraham-seed-promise the Father swore *for ever.* Not church-replacement; covenant-keeping. (Dual-attach: also the anchor of NEW thread magnificat-as-hannah-pattern-and-the-gathering-song-of-the-daughter-of-yasharel.)

thread:scattered-seed-gathering | *He hath holpen his servant Yashar'el (Israel), in remembrance of his mercy; as he spake to our fathers, to Avraham (Abraham), and to his seed for ever.* The gathering Miriam (Mary) is naming is not the church-replacement gathering — it is the Avraham-seed-promise the Father swore *for ever.* The Hoshea (Hosea) 1:10 reversal is the architecture; the Magnificat is the song.

thread:avraham-reckoned-before-circumcision | *As he spake to our fathers, to Avraham (Abraham), and to his seed for ever.* Miriam (Mary) is naming the everlasting covenant of Bereshit (Genesis) 17:7 — *to be a Elohim (God) unto thee, and to thy seed after thee* — and locating her son inside it as the keeping of that oath. The covenant the Reformation collapsed into a faith-confession is here named by a daughter-of-Yashar'el as a paternal-seed-promise to her fathers.

thread:gospel-promised-afore | *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of Yashar'el (Israel); for he hath visited and redeemed his people, and hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David; as he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began.* Zecharyah (Zacharias) names exactly what *gospel-promised-afore* names — the redemption is *as he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets,* the horn-of-salvation rising in the house of David is the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:1 branch out of the stem of Yishai (Jesse).

thread:scattered-seed-gathering | *He hath visited and redeemed his people... that we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us.* The redemption Zecharyah (Zacharias) names is the Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:10 *He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.* The Benedictus is the priestly father's song of the gathering already at the door.

thread:lost-sheep-mission-scope | *I must preach the kingdom of Elohim (God) to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.* The King's *therefore am I sent* names the mission scope — to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), city by city, through the Galilean territory where the scattered live.

thread:my-brethren-substance-distinguishing-the-seed-of-promise-from-the-categorical-nations | *I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel).* The verdict frames the centurion's faith against the seed-of-promise body — the framework's individual-mercy carveout per Red Line #7. The Gentile centurion receives mercy without absorption; the seed-of-promise body remains the audience of the gathering.

thread:great-commission-all-nations-as-territories-of-the-scattered-seed-not-categorical-three-categories-substance | The Twelve sent out at Luke 9 — the same commissioning architecture as Matthew 10, working out the gathering of the scattered seed first through Yashar'eli (Israelite) territory.

thread:great-commission-all-nations-as-territories-of-the-scattered-seed-not-categorical-three-categories-substance | *And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (Luke 13:29) — the four-winds gathering language. NOT the inherited Gentile-inclusion gospel; the prophetic-gathering of the scattered seed of Yashar'el (Israel) from the territories of dispersion. Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 43:5-6 substance.

thread:other-sheep-and-the-lost-house-of-yashar-el | The lost-sheep parable of Luke 15 is the same lost-sheep the King names at Yochanan (John) 10:16 (*And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring*) and Matthew 15:24 (*I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)*). Three witnesses across the gospels to the one substance.

thread:scattered-seed-gathering | The ten-lepers, of whom only the Samaritan returns to glorify Elohim (God). *Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine? There are not found that returned to give glory to Elohim (God), save this stranger* (Luke 17:17-18). Framework reading: the Samaritan is the scattered-seed-of-the-north remembering the covenant — the lost-house-of-Yashar'el thanksgiving in compressed form.

thread:lost-sheep-mission-scope | The King's standing programmatic statement at Zakkay's (Zacchaeus's) house — *the Son of Adam is come to seek and to save that which was lost* — names the same mission scope Matt 10:6 and 15:24 carry: the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel). The seeking-and-saving is the gathering-of-the-scattered, not categorical-nations inclusion.

thread:other-sheep-and-the-lost-house-of-yashar-el | The *that which was lost* of Luke 19:10 and the *other sheep* of Yochanan (John) 10:16 carry the same scattered-seed substance. The King is at the publican's table identifying him as a son of Avraham (Abraham) because the seeking-mission is to the seed already covenant, scattered into the toll-collecting margins of the Roman administration.

thread:gather-together-in-one-the-children-scattered-abroad | *My house shall be called the house of prayer.* Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 56:7's *for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people* names the gathering-substance: the house-of-prayer is the gathering-point where the scattered come home.
